pmu.policy: Median of three process medians of raw user-only kernel counts. No multiplex scaling. Caller/main TID only; control edges included; setup, warmups, encoding and exact checks excluded. Speed changes optimization and register allocation together.

helper_entry_counts.policy: Same-driver authenticated hardware entry counters with fresh eight-case controls for each compiler. Counts overlap and cannot be summed across source/helper populations. Source entry totals are not vector or allocation counts; no multiplication by five arguments.

native_function_extents.scope: Perf-map named symbol extents and containing executable mapping extents; neither is a stack-frame size or live memory measurement.

historical.scope: Archived 5aa compiler leaf sampling only; not refreshed or relabelled for the current compiler.

limits: No fresh leaf sampling or physical allocation census.
Counters and entry instrumentation perturb execution; profiled timings are not scored.
Per-request source/helper entries overlap and do not identify allocation origins or causal removable time.
No fresh old-compiler PMU cohort is claimed; Fast/Speed/V8 PMU data all come from the final diagnostic campaign.
